name: NeRF-XL Joint Training
definition: A method for distributing Neural Radiance Fields across multiple GPUs by allocating NeRF parameters across a disjoint set of spatial regions and training them jointly, enabling arbitrarily large capacity without the redundancy and blending artifacts of independent training.
summary: NeRF-XL Joint Training distributes NeRF parameters across disjoint spatial regions on multiple GPUs, using a single unified optimization to eliminate blending artifacts and embedding inconsistencies found in overlapping methods.
